manualReviewMethod: Individually inspected the nine-artifact staging output by decoding the 480px source-verified JPEGs in a visual display, compared printed body/placard model number with exact Commons File descriptions and published TYM manufacturer model aliases.
legalReviewScope: Commons File pages independently state Own work, uploader MarcelX42, self-assigned CC BY-SA 4.0. Reuse requires photographer attribution, source file and licensing links and attribution when derivatives are resized/re-encoded. No claim to own photographer's images, nor that pictured trims are identical to target specification.
publicationApprovalBasis: Author-source/rights verified, exact physical model badges visible, all three published UUIDs pre-existing in Supabase, exact variant-sensitive binding, nine bytes-backed derivatives SHA-verified in first-party folder, fail-closed release tests and ten-locale ImageObject metadata. Production deploy and live HTTP verification are separately required.
imageReuseScope: Only exact published TYM tractor_id. An illustrative photo is not evidence of engine or transmission option. 2023 exhibit photo must not be captioned as a 2026 shot.
